When so used, any field referencing a 'State or Territory' may be used to indicate New Zealand.
I am seeking registration for the following occupation in New South Wales in accordance with the mutual recognition principle — Driving Instruction.
3. Details of Current Interstate Registration for this Occupation

Note: registration includes any licence, admission, approval, certificate, etc. Specify all the States in which you currently hold or previously held registration for this occupation. A copy of the current registration document(s) or licence must accompany this notice.
Are there any conditions, limitations or restrictions which apply to your registration in any State or Territory? If so, provide details below.
5. Registration Status in Other States or Territories

In relation to the occupation for which registration is sought, I declare that (* cross out whichever is not applicable; provide details if necessary):

(a) I am / am not the subject of disciplinary proceedings in any State or Territory (including preliminary investigations that may lead to disciplinary proceedings) in relation to this occupation; and

(b) My registration in any State or Territory is / is not cancelled or currently suspended as a result of disciplinary action; and

(c) I give consent to Transport for NSW to make enquiries of, and the exchange of information with, the authorities of any State or Territory regarding my activities in the relevant occupation and any other matters relevant to this notice.

ccd_form_strata_community_schemes_applic.text: Complete this form to apply for orders under the Strata Schemes Management Act 2015 or Community Land Management Act 2021. Visit the NCAT website for information on how to complete this form. You can also apply online using NCAT Online Services.

ccd_form_strata_community_schemes_applic.label: Address of the strata or community scheme (include suburb and postcode)

ccd_form_strata_community_schemes_applic.text: C. Owners Corporation or Association Address
The service address for the owners corporation or community/precinct/neighbourhood association can be found on the common property certificate of title.
D. What is your dispute about?

ccd_form_strata_community_schemes_applic.label: Dispute category (select one only)
options: General orders for the settlement of a dispute
Managing agents/building managers or managing statement
Meetings of owners corporation or association
Penalty for breach of by laws
Penalty for breach of Tribunal orders

ccd_form_strata_community_schemes_applic.text: E. Have you tried to settle this dispute through mediation?
Most strata and community schemes applications cannot be accepted without mediation. For mediation requirements check the Strata schemes fact sheet or Community schemes fact sheet.

ccd_form_strata_community_schemes_applic.label: If No — what exemption are you relying on?

ccd_form_strata_community_schemes_applic.text: C. Are you Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander?

ccd_form_strata_community_schemes_applic.label: Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander status
options: Yes - both Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander

ccd_form_strata_community_schemes_applic.text: If the applicant is represented, the representative's contact details will be used as the applicant's address for service. Attach the authority to act for the applicant.
A. What orders do you want?
Write down the section number/s of the Strata Schemes Management Act 2015 or Community Land Management Act 2021, and the orders you want NCAT to make.
B. Why are you applying to NCAT?
Complete this section only if you are asking NCAT to make interim orders. Note: A higher filing fee applies for an application that also asks for interim orders to be made.

ccd_form_strata_community_schemes_applic.label: Reasons for asking for interim orders
Do you need an interpreter for the hearing?

nsw-stat-dec-schedule-9.pdf.text: Statutory Declaration under the Oaths Act 1900, NSW, Ninth Schedule. I, [name of declarant], of [residence], do hereby solemnly declare and affirm that [declaration content].
